name: Gesetz über das Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik und über die Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik von Einrichtungen (BSI-Gesetz — BSIG)
description: German federal statute establishing the mandate and powers of the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI), federal IT/cloud security standards authority, and cybersecurity risk-management, registration, and incident-reporting obligations (§§ 28–39) for essential and important entities and operators of critical facilities.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Bundesministerium der Justiz / Juris (gesetze-im-internet.de) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Bundesministerium der Justiz / Juris (gesetze-im-internet.de).
